question: Select the synonym of **Exquisite.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exquisite"** means something extremely beautiful, carefully made, or finely detailed. It often refers to things of extraordinary quality or elegance. (अति सुंदर, उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's painting was exquisite, capturing every detail with precision.
 
 
 
• **"Delicate"** refers to something that is finely made, fragile, or sensitive in nature. It is often used in the context of beauty or something requiring careful handling. (नाजुक, कोमल)
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a delicate necklace that shimmered under the lights.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Exquisite'** is **'Delicate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Crude** (अशिष्ट, कच्चा): Something in its raw or unrefined state, lacking sophistication or polish.
 
 
• **Example:** The crude oil needs to be refined before it can be used.
 
 
 
• **Harsh** (कठोर): Something that is rough, severe, or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The harsh winter winds made it difficult to go outside.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary** (सामान्य): Something that is common, normal, or lacking in uniqueness.
 
 
• **Example:** He had an ordinary day at work without any surprises.
